stem: How is the main activity in the poem “A Wave of a Day” DIFFERENT from the main activity in the excerpt from The Last Wild Place?

options.label: A
options.text: It gives the characters a way to spend time together.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the topic of an argument between the characters.

options.label: C
options.text: It brings the characters even closer together.

options.label: D
options.text: It is done at the same time by both characters.

visual_elements: Multiple choice question with four options labeled A, B, C, and D.
